user.title: Set up Lishui Water
user.description: Enter your water meter details to fetch bills.

data_description.card_no: The customer/meter number shown on your bill or in the WeChat mini-program
data_description.token: Optional token from the WeChat mini-program; leave blank when not required

reauth_confirm.title: Renew token
reauth_confirm.description: The token for water meter {card_no} is invalid or has expired. Paste a fresh token to continue.

reconfigure.title: Change billing year
reconfigure.description: Update the billing year queried for water meter {card_no}. The API answers per year, so a new year may not have a bill yet.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the Lishui water API
error.no_data: No bill was found for this meter number and billing year. Check both values, or select an earlier billing year.

abort.already_configured: This water meter is already configured

data_description.scan_interval: How often to fetch bills; billing data changes monthly, 6h is plenty
